reply: {"verses": [], "overall": "The translation is faithful to the Latin throughout: tenses (futures in 82:2, 82:16, 82:17), moods (jussives in 82:18-19, imperatives in 82:10-14) and the Septuagintal readings (extulerunt caput, filiis Lot, stercus terrae, rotam) are all kept, and the pointing marks match the Latin verse by verse, including the second-half asterisk placement in 82:12. The one borderline choice, 82:5 'para não serem nação' for 'disperdamus eos de gente', renders the idiom 'destroy them from being a nation' correctly rather than explaining it, so it is not flagged."}
